_policy: File length is a soft signal, never a reason to split. A file over the arch_fitness soft cap warns until it is split along a domain boundary or listed here with a reason, an approver and an expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD). Expired entries warn again. Paths are relative to FHD/ for app and to the XCMAX root for modstore_server.
